let σ : Equiv.Perm ι := ⟨Fintype.equivFin (Fintype.card ι), by apply_instance⟩
have hperm : Antivary f ∘ σ g := by apply Antivary.permuted
have hsum : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f (σ i) * g (σ i) := Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_mul_comp_perm hfg σ
have htotal : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f i * g i := by rw [Nat.cast_id, sum_eq_sum]
have hsum2 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * (∑ i, g i) :=
  let s := ∑ i, f i
  let t := ∑ i, g i
  have h1 : s * t = ∑ i, ∑ j, f i * g j := by rw [sum_prod]
  have h2 : ∑ i, ∑ j, f i * g j = ∑ j, ∑ i, f i * g j := by rw [sum_comm]
  have h3 : ∑ j, ∑ i, f i * g j = ∑ j, g j * s := by rw [sum_const_mul]
  have h4 : ∑ j, g j * s = s * t := by rw [mul_comm, h3]
  have h5 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ s * t := by rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  h5
calc
  ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f i * g i : by rw [Nat.cast_id, mul_one]
  ... ≤ s * t : hsum2
  ... = (∑ i, f i) * (∑ i, g i) : rfl
